title: Planning gives each case a sprint goal clause lists (providers, statuses) a check in the item that carries the clause
goal: precheck SP warns when a sprint goal clause names a list of cases (such as 'a GitHub, arXiv or PyPI answer' or 'a failed request') and the carrying item's goal or checks name only some of them, so a narrower item goal is widened or the clause reworded before the start gate. SP-vk3wf746 close: BG-o3zppi2w checked GitHub and arXiv shapes but no PyPI answer, and BG-npdpbmw2 named status 0 where the sprint goal said a failed request; the review found both (BG-x4lhztge, BG-2ksqvskp).

run:
import sys,tempfile,subprocess,io,contextlib,argparse,os
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base,bl_land
def one(**v):
    return {'BG-bbbbbbbb': v}
def run(sg,items,files=()):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True)
    for p,t in files:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,p)),exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(d,p),'w').write(t)
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'add','-A'],check=True)
    bl=bl_base.Backlog(d)
    bl.items['SP-aaaaaaaa']=dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa',kind='sprint',title='s',status='planned',goal=sg)
    for k,v in items.items():
        it=dict(id=k,sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',status='draft',title='t',checks=[dict(run=['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)'])])
        it.update(v)
        bl.items[k]=it
    o=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(o):
        bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl,argparse.Namespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
    return [l for l in o.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
sg='A lookup returns a GitHub, arXiv or PyPI answer.'
narrow=run(sg,one(kind='story',goal='The fetch shapes a GitHub and an arXiv answer.',touches=['x.py']))
full=run(sg,one(kind='story',goal='The fetch shapes a GitHub, an arXiv and a PyPI answer.',touches=['x.py']))
sys.exit(0 if any('PyPI' in l for l in narrow) and not any('PyPI' in l for l in full) else 1)
